rules.punch_rows: reuse='insert' + punch=true + clip_window: a post re-crop of a LATER window of the same take; MAY sit next to its source (same-take continuation, the bible's hook technique); never two punches of one take back-to-back

rules.slot_rule: for every row t_out - t_in <= duration_s; for unique rows slot + sum(punch slots) <= duration_s (the generated length)
rules.partial: characters listed in `partial` appear only as a body part (hand/anklet/goggle/fur wall): identity QA checks colour + material, not the face
